This isolated patch covers runtime argparse -- terminator handling for batch and single conversion entrypoints: tokens after -- are reviewed as positionals, option-looking WordPress folder/upload names are admitted only after the separator, and parse failures before the separator still block before side effects. No Python, CUDA, OCR, model execution, multiprocessing, raster decoding, PDF action execution, or external PDF tools run.
